instructions.name: initialize_config
instructions.title: Initialize Whirlpools config
instructions.rationale: Creates a WhirlpoolsConfig and assigns its fee, protocol-fee and reward authorities. The funder must be one of the program's hard-coded ADMINS keys.
instructions.notes: Both the new config keypair and the funder sign. The ADMINS list is compiled into the program (auth/admin.rs), so only those keys can create configs.

instructions.name: initialize_pool
instructions.title: Create pool (SPL Token)
instructions.rationale: Creates a pool and two token vaults at a caller-chosen initial price; funder pays rent. Permissionless and unneeded for swapping or LP on existing pools.
instructions.notes: Classified other, not admin: it is permissionless, but it creates a market at a caller-chosen price using the funder's SOL, so it is denied by default. The two vault keypairs sign. SPL Token mints only; initialize_pool_v2 adds Token-2022.

instructions.name: initialize_tick_array
instructions.title: Initialize tick array
instructions.rationale: Creates a fixed-size tick-array account covering a price range; the funder pays rent. Permissionless setup step before opening positions or swapping through that range.
instructions.notes: Permissionless; only SOL rent is spent and no tokens move. Classified position_mgmt because it prepares pool state for LP flows. start_tick_index must be a multiple of the tick-array size times the pool tick spacing. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): start_tick_index i32 @8.

instructions.name: initialize_dynamic_tick_array
instructions.title: Initialize dynamic tick array
instructions.rationale: Creates a variable-length tick-array account covering a price range; the funder pays rent. Permissionless setup step before opening positions or swapping through that range.
instructions.notes: Permissionless; only SOL rent is spent and no tokens move. Classified position_mgmt because it prepares pool state for LP flows. With idempotent=1 the call succeeds without changes if a fixed or dynamic tick array already exists. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): start_tick_index i32 @8, idempotent bool @12.

instructions.name: initialize_fee_tier
instructions.title: Initialize fee tier
instructions.rationale: Creates a fee-tier account that sets the default fee rate for a tick spacing. Only the config's fee authority may sign.
instructions.notes: Signers: fee_authority (stored in the WhirlpoolsConfig) and funder. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): tick_spacing u16 @8, default_fee_rate u16 @10.

instructions.name: initialize_reward
instructions.title: Initialize pool reward (SPL Token)
instructions.rationale: Sets up a liquidity-mining reward slot and vault on a pool. Signed by the pool's reward authority; the funder pays rent.
instructions.notes: Signers: reward_authority, funder and the new reward_vault keypair. SPL Token rewards only; initialize_reward_v2 covers Token-2022. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): reward_index u8 @8.

instructions.name: set_reward_emissions
instructions.title: Set reward emissions
instructions.rationale: Changes the emission rate of one pool reward. Only that reward's authority may sign.
instructions.notes: See set_reward_emissions_v2 for Token-2022 reward vaults. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): reward_index u8 @8, emissions_per_second_x64 u128 @9.

instructions.name: open_position
instructions.title: Open position (SPL Token NFT)
instructions.rationale: Creates an empty position and mints its NFT to a caller-chosen owner; the funder pays rent. No tokens move.
instructions.notes: The owner account is an arbitrary non-signer, so the NFT (and control of the position) can be sent to any wallet. Fails with PositionWithTokenExtensionsRequired on pools that require Token-2022 positions. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): bumps.position_bump u8 @8, tick_lower_index i32 @9, tick_upper_index i32 @13.

instructions.name: open_position_with_metadata
instructions.title: Open position with metadata (SPL Token NFT)
instructions.rationale: Creates an empty position and mints its NFT, with Metaplex metadata, to a caller-chosen owner; the funder pays rent. No tokens move.
instructions.notes: The owner account is an arbitrary non-signer, so the NFT (and control of the position) can be sent to any wallet. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): bumps.position_bump u8 @8, bumps.metadata_bump u8 @9, tick_lower_index i32 @10, tick_upper_index i32 @14.

instructions.name: increase_liquidity
instructions.title: Add liquidity
instructions.rationale: Deposits tokens from the signer's accounts into a position; token_max_a/b cap the amounts taken. Position authority signs.
instructions.notes: No single canonical amount: liquidity_amount is in liquidity units and the spend is capped per token by token_max_a and token_max_b (two different mints), so amount is null. Served by the Pinocchio fast path in entrypoint.rs; discriminator and Borsh layout are the same as the Anchor ones. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): liquidity_amount u128 @8, token_max_a u64 @24, token_max_b u64 @32.

instructions.name: decrease_liquidity
instructions.title: Remove liquidity
instructions.rationale: Withdraws liquidity to caller-chosen token accounts of the pool's mints, not tied to the position owner; token_min_a/b are slippage floors. Position authority signs.
instructions.notes: Payout token accounts are only checked against the pool mint, not against the position owner, so a mandate must pin them. Fails with OperationNotAllowedOnLockedPosition once the position is locked. Served by the Pinocchio fast path in entrypoint.rs; discriminator and Borsh layout are the same as the Anchor ones. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): liquidity_amount u128 @8, token_min_a u64 @24, token_min_b u64 @32.

instructions.name: update_fees_and_rewards
instructions.title: Update fees and rewards
instructions.rationale: Permissionless crank that refreshes a position's accrued fee and reward counters on-chain. No tokens move.
instructions.notes: No signer is required. Classified position_mgmt rather than read_only because it writes fee and reward state to the pool and position accounts. Fails with LiquidityZero when the position has no liquidity.

instructions.name: collect_fees
instructions.title: Collect fees
instructions.rationale: Pays a position's accrued trading fees from the pool vaults to caller-chosen token accounts of the pool's mints. Position authority signs.
instructions.notes: Payout token accounts are only checked against the pool mint, not against the position owner, so a mandate must pin them. The amount is whatever the position has accrued; there is no amount argument. SPL Token only; see collect_fees_v2.

instructions.name: collect_reward
instructions.title: Collect reward
instructions.rationale: Pays a position's accrued liquidity-mining reward from the reward vault to a caller-chosen token account of the reward mint. Position authority signs.
instructions.notes: The reward token account is only checked against the reward mint, not against the position owner, so a mandate must pin it. No amount argument. SPL Token only; see collect_reward_v2. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): reward_index u8 @8.

instructions.name: collect_protocol_fees
instructions.title: Collect protocol fees
instructions.rationale: Sweeps accrued protocol fees from pool vaults to caller-chosen accounts. Only the config's collect-protocol-fees authority may sign.
instructions.notes: Not a user action: protocol fees belong to the config's collect_protocol_fees_authority. No amount argument. SPL Token only; see collect_protocol_fees_v2.

instructions.name: swap
instructions.title: Swap (SPL Token)
instructions.rationale: Swaps one pool token for the other; output may go to any token account of the output mint. Needs spend limit and output floor.
instructions.notes: amount is the INPUT amount only when amount_specified_is_input (bool @40) is 1; other_amount_threshold (u64 @16) is then the minimum output. When the flag is 0, amount is the desired OUTPUT and the spend is bounded only by other_amount_threshold (the maximum input), so a cap on amount alone does not bound the spend: require the flag to be 1 or cap other_amount_threshold too. The output token account is only mint-checked, so it can belong to anyone. SPL Token only; see swap_v2. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): amount u64 @8, other_amount_threshold u64 @16, sqrt_price_limit u128 @24, amount_specified_is_input bool @40, a_to_b bool @41.

instructions.name: close_position
instructions.title: Close position (SPL Token NFT)
instructions.rationale: Burns the position NFT and closes the position and token accounts; rent goes to a caller-chosen receiver. Allowed only when the position is empty.
instructions.notes: Empty means no liquidity and no fees or rewards owed (ClosePositionNotEmpty otherwise). The mint account is not closed. receiver is an arbitrary account that only receives rent.

instructions.name: set_default_fee_rate
instructions.title: Set fee tier default fee rate
instructions.rationale: Changes the default fee rate a fee tier gives to new pools. Only the config's fee authority may sign.
instructions.notes: Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): default_fee_rate u16 @8.

instructions.name: set_default_protocol_fee_rate
instructions.title: Set default protocol fee rate
instructions.rationale: Changes the default protocol fee rate for new pools in a config. Only the config's fee authority may sign.
instructions.notes: Rate is in basis points per the program docs. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): default_protocol_fee_rate u16 @8.

instructions.name: set_fee_rate
instructions.title: Set pool fee rate
instructions.rationale: Changes the swap fee rate of one pool. Only the config's fee authority may sign.
instructions.notes: Rate is in hundredths of a basis point per the program docs. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): fee_rate u16 @8.

instructions.name: set_protocol_fee_rate
instructions.title: Set pool protocol fee rate
instructions.rationale: Changes the protocol fee rate of one pool. Only the config's fee authority may sign.
instructions.notes: Rate is in basis points per the program docs. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): protocol_fee_rate u16 @8.

instructions.name: set_fee_authority
instructions.title: Set fee authority
instructions.rationale: Reassigns the config's fee authority to a new key, which then controls fee rates and fee tiers. The current fee authority signs.
instructions.notes: The new authority is passed as an account (new_fee_authority), not in instruction data.

instructions.name: set_collect_protocol_fees_authority
instructions.title: Set protocol-fee collection authority
instructions.rationale: Reassigns the config's protocol-fee collection authority, which can sweep protocol fees. The current collect-protocol-fees authority signs.
instructions.notes: The new authority is passed as an account, not in instruction data.

instructions.name: set_reward_authority
instructions.title: Set pool reward authority
instructions.rationale: Reassigns the authority of one pool reward index, which controls its emissions. The current reward authority signs.
instructions.notes: The new authority is passed as an account, not in instruction data. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): reward_index u8 @8.

instructions.name: set_reward_authority_by_super_authority
instructions.title: Set pool reward authority (super authority)
instructions.rationale: Reassigns a pool reward's authority using the config's reward super authority, overriding the current reward authority.
instructions.notes: The new authority is passed as an account, not in instruction data. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): reward_index u8 @8.

instructions.name: set_reward_emissions_super_authority
instructions.title: Set reward super authority
instructions.rationale: Reassigns the config's reward super authority, which can reassign every pool reward authority. The current super authority signs.
instructions.notes: The new authority is passed as an account, not in instruction data.

instructions.name: two_hop_swap
instructions.title: Two-hop swap (SPL Token)
instructions.rationale: Swaps through two pools atomically; the final output may go to any token account of the output mint. Needs spend limit and output floor.
instructions.notes: amount is the INPUT amount only when amount_specified_is_input (bool @24) is 1; other_amount_threshold (u64 @16) is then the minimum output. When the flag is 0, amount is the desired OUTPUT and the spend is bounded only by other_amount_threshold (the maximum input), so a cap on amount alone does not bound the spend: require the flag to be 1 or cap other_amount_threshold too. The output token account is only mint-checked, so it can belong to anyone. For two hops, amount refers to the first pool's input (exact-in) or the second pool's output (exact-out). SPL Token only; see two_hop_swap_v2. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): amount u64 @8, other_amount_threshold u64 @16, amount_specified_is_input bool @24, a_to_b_one bool @25, a_to_b_two bool @26, sqrt_price_limit_one u128 @27, sqrt_price_limit_two u128 @43.

instructions.name: initialize_position_bundle
instructions.title: Initialize position bundle
instructions.rationale: Creates a position-bundle account (many positions under one NFT) and mints its NFT to a caller-chosen owner; the funder pays rent.
instructions.notes: Signers: position_bundle_mint keypair and funder. The bundle owner is an arbitrary account, so the NFT can be sent to any wallet.

instructions.name: initialize_position_bundle_with_metadata
instructions.title: Initialize position bundle with metadata
instructions.rationale: Creates a position-bundle account and mints its NFT, with Metaplex metadata, to a caller-chosen owner; the funder pays rent.
instructions.notes: Signers: position_bundle_mint keypair and funder. The bundle owner is an arbitrary account, so the NFT can be sent to any wallet.

instructions.name: delete_position_bundle
instructions.title: Delete position bundle
instructions.rationale: Burns the position-bundle NFT and closes the bundle and token accounts; rent goes to a caller-chosen receiver. Allowed only with no open positions.
instructions.notes: The bundle owner signs. PositionBundleNotDeletable if any bundled position is still open.

instructions.name: open_bundled_position
instructions.title: Open bundled position
instructions.rationale: Opens an empty position at a chosen index inside a position bundle; no new NFT is issued. Bundle authority signs and the funder pays rent.
instructions.notes: The bundle owner becomes the owner of the new position. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): bundle_index u16 @8, tick_lower_index i32 @10, tick_upper_index i32 @14.

instructions.name: close_bundled_position
instructions.title: Close bundled position
instructions.rationale: Closes an empty bundled position and frees its bundle index; rent goes to a caller-chosen receiver. Bundle authority signs.
instructions.notes: ClosePositionNotEmpty if liquidity, fees or rewards remain. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): bundle_index u16 @8.

instructions.name: open_position_with_token_extensions
instructions.title: Open position (Token-2022 NFT)
instructions.rationale: Creates an empty position and mints a Token-2022 NFT to a caller-chosen owner; the funder pays rent. No tokens move.
instructions.notes: The owner account is an arbitrary non-signer, so the NFT (and control of the position) can be sent to any wallet. with_token_metadata_extension toggles the TokenMetadata extension. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): tick_lower_index i32 @8, tick_upper_index i32 @12, with_token_metadata_extension bool @16.

instructions.name: close_position_with_token_extensions
instructions.title: Close position (Token-2022 NFT)
instructions.rationale: Burns the Token-2022 position NFT and closes the position, token and mint accounts; rent goes to a caller-chosen receiver. Allowed only when empty.
instructions.notes: Rejects locked positions (OperationNotAllowedOnLockedPosition) and non-empty positions (ClosePositionNotEmpty). receiver is an arbitrary account that only receives rent.

instructions.name: lock_position
instructions.title: Lock position (permanent)
instructions.rationale: Permanently freezes the position NFT and blocks liquidity withdrawal, so principal can never be removed. Irreversible; position authority and funder sign.
instructions.notes: LockType has a single variant, Permanent, and no unlock instruction exists. After locking, decrease_liquidity(_v2), reposition_liquidity_v2 and close_position_with_token_extensions fail with OperationNotAllowedOnLockedPosition; the NFT can still move via transfer_locked_position. Token-2022 positions with liquidity only. Classified other (not authority_change) because it removes the owner's own access rather than granting it to someone else. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): lock_type.tag(Permanent=0) u8 @8.

instructions.name: reset_position_range
instructions.title: Reset position range
instructions.rationale: Changes the tick range of an empty position (no liquidity, fees or rewards owed). Position authority signs; the funder tops up rent. No tokens move.
instructions.notes: Rejects the current range (SameTickRangeNotAllowed) and any non-empty position (ClosePositionNotEmpty). Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): new_tick_lower_index i32 @8, new_tick_upper_index i32 @12.

instructions.name: transfer_locked_position
instructions.title: Transfer locked position
instructions.rationale: Moves a locked position NFT to a caller-chosen token account, transferring control of the position. Only the NFT owner, not a delegate, may sign.
instructions.notes: The destination token account may belong to anyone. The receiver account only gets the rent of the closed source token account.

instructions.name: initialize_adaptive_fee_tier
instructions.title: Initialize adaptive fee tier
instructions.rationale: Creates an adaptive fee tier with its fee constants and its pool-initialization and fee-delegation authorities. Only the config's fee authority may sign.
instructions.notes: Signers: fee_authority (stored in the WhirlpoolsConfig) and funder. Arguments: fee_tier_index, tick_spacing, initialize_pool_authority, delegated_fee_authority, default_base_fee_rate and the seven adaptive-fee constants.

instructions.name: set_default_base_fee_rate
instructions.title: Set adaptive tier base fee rate
instructions.rationale: Changes the default base fee rate of an adaptive fee tier. Only the config's fee authority may sign.
instructions.notes: Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): default_base_fee_rate u16 @8.

instructions.name: set_delegated_fee_authority
instructions.title: Set delegated fee authority
instructions.rationale: Reassigns the delegated fee authority of an adaptive fee tier, which can set pool fee rates. The config's fee authority signs.
instructions.notes: The new authority is passed as an account, not in instruction data.

instructions.name: set_initialize_pool_authority
instructions.title: Set pool-initialization authority
instructions.rationale: Reassigns the authority allowed to create pools in an adaptive fee tier. The config's fee authority signs.
instructions.notes: The new authority is passed as an account, not in instruction data.

instructions.name: set_preset_adaptive_fee_constants
instructions.title: Set adaptive tier fee constants
instructions.rationale: Changes the adaptive-fee constants preset of an adaptive fee tier. Only the config's fee authority may sign.
instructions.notes: Sets seven constants at once: filter_period, decay_period, reduction_factor, adaptive_fee_control_factor, max_volatility_accumulator, tick_group_size and major_swap_threshold_ticks.

instructions.name: initialize_pool_with_adaptive_fee
instructions.title: Create pool (adaptive fee)
instructions.rationale: Creates an adaptive-fee pool and its oracle at a caller-chosen price; funder pays rent. Permissioned tiers also need the tier's pool-initialization authority.
instructions.notes: Classified other, like initialize_pool: it creates a market using the funder's SOL and is irrelevant to trading or LP on existing pools, so it is denied by default. trade_enable_timestamp is rejected on permissionless tiers. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): initial_sqrt_price u128 @8, trade_enable_timestamp Option<u64> @24 (variable length from here).

instructions.name: set_fee_rate_by_delegated_fee_authority
instructions.title: Set pool fee rate (delegated)
instructions.rationale: Changes the fee rate of one pool; signed by the adaptive fee tier's delegated fee authority.
instructions.notes: Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): fee_rate u16 @8.

instructions.name: set_adaptive_fee_constants
instructions.title: Set pool adaptive fee constants
instructions.rationale: Changes selected adaptive-fee constants on one pool's oracle. Only the config's fee authority may sign.
instructions.notes: Program docs warn against calling it while the pool's adaptive fee is high, to avoid LP revenue loss. Every argument is an Option and only provided values change.

instructions.name: set_config_feature_flag
instructions.title: Set config feature flag
instructions.rationale: Sets a feature flag (token-badge support) on a WhirlpoolsConfig. The signer must be one of the program's hard-coded ADMINS keys.
instructions.notes: ConfigFeatureFlag has a single variant, TokenBadge(bool). Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): feature_flag.tag(TokenBadge=0) u8 @8, feature_flag.value bool @9.

instructions.name: migrate_repurpose_reward_authority_space
instructions.title: Migrate reward-authority space
instructions.rationale: Permissionless one-off migration that zeroes reward-info extension fields of a pool account; needs no signer. Removed from the source after 0.9.0.
instructions.notes: Present in the 0.9.0 release source and found in the deployed mainnet and devnet binaries, but removed from main by commit f6db412595 (2026-10-06), so a future upgrade built from main will no longer accept it. Panics if the pool was already migrated. Only the whirlpool account is passed.

instructions.name: collect_fees_v2
instructions.title: Collect fees v2 (Token/Token-2022)
instructions.rationale: Pays a position's accrued trading fees from the pool vaults to caller-chosen token accounts of the pool's mints. Position authority signs.
instructions.notes: Payout token accounts are only checked against the pool mint, not against the position owner, so a mandate must pin them. The amount is whatever the position has accrued; there is no amount argument. v2 works with SPL Token and Token-2022 mints (transfer fee, transfer hook and memo support via remaining_accounts_info).

instructions.name: collect_protocol_fees_v2
instructions.title: Collect protocol fees v2 (Token/Token-2022)
instructions.rationale: Sweeps accrued protocol fees from pool vaults to caller-chosen accounts. Only the config's collect-protocol-fees authority may sign.
instructions.notes: Not a user action: protocol fees belong to the config's collect_protocol_fees_authority. No amount argument. v2 works with SPL Token and Token-2022 mints (transfer fee, transfer hook and memo support via remaining_accounts_info).

instructions.name: collect_reward_v2
instructions.title: Collect reward v2 (Token/Token-2022)
instructions.rationale: Pays a position's accrued liquidity-mining reward from the reward vault to a caller-chosen token account of the reward mint. Position authority signs.
instructions.notes: The reward token account is only checked against the reward mint, not against the position owner, so a mandate must pin it. No amount argument. v2 works with SPL Token and Token-2022 mints (transfer fee, transfer hook and memo support via remaining_accounts_info). Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): reward_index u8 @8, remaining_accounts_info Option<RemainingAccountsInfo> @9 (variable length from here).

instructions.name: decrease_liquidity_v2
instructions.title: Remove liquidity v2 (Token/Token-2022)
instructions.rationale: Withdraws liquidity to caller-chosen token accounts of the pool's mints, not tied to the position owner; token_min_a/b are slippage floors. Position authority signs.
instructions.notes: Payout token accounts are only checked against the pool mint, not against the position owner, so a mandate must pin them. Fails with OperationNotAllowedOnLockedPosition once the position is locked. v2 works with SPL Token and Token-2022 mints (transfer fee, transfer hook and memo support via remaining_accounts_info). Served by the Pinocchio fast path in entrypoint.rs; discriminator and Borsh layout are the same as the Anchor ones. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): liquidity_amount u128 @8, token_min_a u64 @24, token_min_b u64 @32, remaining_accounts_info Option<RemainingAccountsInfo> @40 (variable length from here).

instructions.name: increase_liquidity_v2
instructions.title: Add liquidity v2 (Token/Token-2022)
instructions.rationale: Deposits tokens from the signer's accounts into a position; token_max_a/b cap the amounts taken. Position authority signs.
instructions.notes: No single canonical amount: liquidity_amount is in liquidity units and the spend is capped per token by token_max_a and token_max_b (two different mints), so amount is null. v2 works with SPL Token and Token-2022 mints (transfer fee, transfer hook and memo support via remaining_accounts_info). Served by the Pinocchio fast path in entrypoint.rs; discriminator and Borsh layout are the same as the Anchor ones. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): liquidity_amount u128 @8, token_max_a u64 @24, token_max_b u64 @32, remaining_accounts_info Option<RemainingAccountsInfo> @40 (variable length from here).

instructions.name: increase_liquidity_by_token_amounts_v2
instructions.title: Add liquidity by token amounts v2
instructions.rationale: Deposits up to the given token maxima into a position, deriving liquidity on-chain within a sqrt-price window. Position authority signs.
instructions.notes: No single canonical amount: two token maxima apply (token_max_a, token_max_b), so amount is null. Implemented only in the Pinocchio fast path; the Anchor handler is an unreachable stub. Present in the 0.9.0 source and found in the deployed mainnet and devnet binaries. method is a single-variant enum (ByTokenAmounts, tag 0). v2 works with SPL Token and Token-2022 mints (transfer fee, transfer hook and memo support via remaining_accounts_info). Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): method.tag(ByTokenAmounts=0) u8 @8, method.token_max_a u64 @9, method.token_max_b u64 @17, method.min_sqrt_price u128 @25, method.max_sqrt_price u128 @41, remaining_accounts_info Option<RemainingAccountsInfo> @57 (variable length from here).

instructions.name: initialize_pool_v2
instructions.title: Create pool v2 (Token/Token-2022)
instructions.rationale: Creates a pool and two token vaults at a caller-chosen initial price; funder pays rent. Permissionless and unneeded for swapping or LP on existing pools.
instructions.notes: Classified other, not admin: it is permissionless, but it creates a market at a caller-chosen price using the funder's SOL, so it is denied by default. The two vault keypairs sign. Works with SPL Token and Token-2022 mints; some Token-2022 mints are accepted only with a TokenBadge. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): tick_spacing u16 @8, initial_sqrt_price u128 @10.

instructions.name: initialize_reward_v2
instructions.title: Initialize pool reward v2 (Token/Token-2022)
instructions.rationale: Sets up a liquidity-mining reward slot and vault on a pool. Signed by the pool's reward authority; the funder pays rent.
instructions.notes: Signers: reward_authority, funder and the new reward_vault keypair. Works with SPL Token and Token-2022 reward mints; some Token-2022 mints are accepted only with a TokenBadge. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): reward_index u8 @8.

instructions.name: set_reward_emissions_v2
instructions.title: Set reward emissions v2
instructions.rationale: Changes the emission rate of one pool reward. Only that reward's authority may sign.
instructions.notes: Works with Token and Token-2022 reward vaults. Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): reward_index u8 @8, emissions_per_second_x64 u128 @9.

instructions.name: swap_v2
instructions.title: Swap v2 (Token/Token-2022)
instructions.rationale: Swaps one pool token for the other; output may go to any token account of the output mint. Needs spend limit and output floor.
instructions.notes: amount is the INPUT amount only when amount_specified_is_input (bool @40) is 1; other_amount_threshold (u64 @16) is then the minimum output. When the flag is 0, amount is the desired OUTPUT and the spend is bounded only by other_amount_threshold (the maximum input), so a cap on amount alone does not bound the spend: require the flag to be 1 or cap other_amount_threshold too. The output token account is only mint-checked, so it can belong to anyone. v2 works with SPL Token and Token-2022 mints (transfer fee, transfer hook and memo support via remaining_accounts_info). Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): amount u64 @8, other_amount_threshold u64 @16, sqrt_price_limit u128 @24, amount_specified_is_input bool @40, a_to_b bool @41, remaining_accounts_info Option<RemainingAccountsInfo> @42 (variable length from here).

instructions.name: two_hop_swap_v2
instructions.title: Two-hop swap v2 (Token/Token-2022)
instructions.rationale: Swaps through two pools atomically; the final output may go to any token account of the output mint. Needs spend limit and output floor.
instructions.notes: amount is the INPUT amount only when amount_specified_is_input (bool @24) is 1; other_amount_threshold (u64 @16) is then the minimum output. When the flag is 0, amount is the desired OUTPUT and the spend is bounded only by other_amount_threshold (the maximum input), so a cap on amount alone does not bound the spend: require the flag to be 1 or cap other_amount_threshold too. The output token account is only mint-checked, so it can belong to anyone. For two hops, amount refers to the first pool's input (exact-in) or the second pool's output (exact-out). v2 works with SPL Token and Token-2022 mints (transfer fee, transfer hook and memo support via remaining_accounts_info). Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): amount u64 @8, other_amount_threshold u64 @16, amount_specified_is_input bool @24, a_to_b_one bool @25, a_to_b_two bool @26, sqrt_price_limit_one u128 @27, sqrt_price_limit_two u128 @43, remaining_accounts_info Option<RemainingAccountsInfo> @59 (variable length from here).

instructions.name: reposition_liquidity_v2
instructions.title: Reposition liquidity v2
instructions.rationale: Atomically withdraws a position's liquidity, moves it to a new tick range and redeposits within the given token bounds. Position authority and funder sign.
instructions.notes: No single canonical amount: four token bounds apply (existing_range_token_min_a/b, new_range_token_max_a/b), so amount is null. Only the net token delta moves (owner to vault if the new range needs more, otherwise vault to owner); token_owner_account_a/b are not owner-checked, so a mandate must pin them. Rejects locked positions. Implemented only in the Pinocchio fast path; the Anchor handler is an unreachable stub. v2 works with SPL Token and Token-2022 mints (transfer fee, transfer hook and memo support via remaining_accounts_info). Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): new_tick_lower_index i32 @8, new_tick_upper_index i32 @12, method.tag(ByLiquidity=0) u8 @16, method.new_liquidity_amount u128 @17, method.existing_range_token_min_a u64 @33, method.existing_range_token_min_b u64 @41, method.new_range_token_max_a u64 @49, method.new_range_token_max_b u64 @57, remaining_accounts_info Option<RemainingAccountsInfo> @65 (variable length from here).

instructions.name: initialize_config_extension
instructions.title: Initialize config extension
instructions.rationale: Creates the WhirlpoolsConfigExtension account that holds the config extension and token-badge authorities. Only the config's fee authority may sign.
instructions.notes: Signers: funder and the config's fee_authority.

instructions.name: set_config_extension_authority
instructions.title: Set config extension authority
instructions.rationale: Reassigns the config extension authority, which controls the token-badge authority. The current config extension authority signs.
instructions.notes: The new authority is passed as an account, not in instruction data.

instructions.name: set_token_badge_authority
instructions.title: Set token badge authority
instructions.rationale: Reassigns the token badge authority, which creates, edits and deletes TokenBadges. The config extension authority signs.
instructions.notes: The new authority is passed as an account, not in instruction data.

instructions.name: initialize_token_badge
instructions.title: Initialize token badge
instructions.rationale: Creates a TokenBadge that lets a Token-2022 mint with otherwise-rejected features be used in pools and rewards. Only the token badge authority may sign.
instructions.notes: FeatureIsNotEnabled unless the config's TokenBadge feature flag is on.

instructions.name: delete_token_badge
instructions.title: Delete token badge
instructions.rationale: Closes a TokenBadge account, withdrawing that mint's exemption; rent goes to a caller-chosen receiver. Only the token badge authority may sign.
instructions.notes: FeatureIsNotEnabled unless the config's TokenBadge feature flag is on.

instructions.name: set_token_badge_attribute
instructions.title: Set token badge attribute
instructions.rationale: Sets an attribute on a TokenBadge, such as requiring non-transferable positions. Only the token badge authority may sign.
instructions.notes: TokenBadgeAttribute has a single variant, RequireNonTransferablePosition(bool). Layout after the 8-byte discriminator (raw offsets, little-endian): attribute.tag(RequireNonTransferablePosition=0) u8 @8, attribute.value bool @9.

instructions.name: idl_include
instructions.title: IDL placeholder (always fails)
instructions.rationale: IDL-only stub that always fails with InvalidInstructionData; it exists so the IDL includes DynamicTickArray. Changes no state.
instructions.notes: Source comment: "Only for inclusion in the IDL". Takes only system_program. Unrelated to the two Anchor framework dispatch branches that the deployed binaries also contain and that are not listed in this file: IDL management (8-byte tag 40f4bc78a7e9690a) and event CPI (tag e445a52e51cb9a1d).
